experimental_method: Microgasometric technique: degassed water (distilled or seawater) equilibrated with pure CO2 gas in a chamber, gas volume change measured (6-10 min equilibration); corrected for non-ideality and dissociation.
uncertainties_stated: Overall accuracy of the microgasometric CO2 solubility measurements estimated +-0.2 percent; average deviation 1.5e-5 and rms deviation 1.2e-4 mol/L atm from the fitted Murray and Riley curve; salinity +-0.004 permil.
quality_remarks: CO2 purity >99.99 percent (0.01 percent air). Author's own measurements confirm Murray and Riley (1971) and show Li and Tsui (1971) seawater data in error by up to ~4 percent. Printed table header K0 x 10^2 (text layer said 10^5).
not_extracted_tables: Table I (page 208): fitted constants of eq. 12 - model parameters.
Table II (page 209): K0 (mol/L atm) vs T and salinity, calculated from the fit to corrected Murray and Riley data - derived/fitted.
Table III (page 210): K0 (mol/kg atm) vs T and salinity, calculated from the fit - derived/fitted.
Murray and Riley, Bohr, Krogh, Li and Tsui data are only referenced, not tabulated.
changes_after_image_check: table_1 header: K0 * 10^5 -> K0 * 10^2 (text layer error)
extraction_notes: Rows are replicate determinations at 0.0 permil/20.6 C (5), 35.330 permil/6.6 C (4) and 35.330 permil/20.6 C (6). Sanity check: values compatible with Table II (e.g. 3.91e-2 at 20 C, S=0). Header text-layer correction counted.
needs_pass2_reason: One header correction was needed after the image check (rule: any correction counts); cell values themselves all matched.
pass2_diff: Table IV: 15 rows identical (first three columns).
